Project Title: ai-ml-ds-MLTPatterns007
File Name: advanced_multimodal_temporal_anomaly_pattern_mining_with_pandas.py

Before diving into the code, here’s a brief overview of what follows:

We construct a “Multimodal Temporal Anomaly and Pattern Mining” pipeline entirely in Pandas, integrating tabular time series, text logs (via HuggingFace embeddings), and graph‑based relational data (via NetworkX) to detect anomalies and discover latent patterns. The solution leverages scalable loading (Dask), advanced feature extraction (TSFresh), and hybrid modeling (scikit‑learn + PyOD), culminating in a unified DataFrame that powers both analytic queries and downstream ML. (Pandas, Turing, GitHub, GitHub, InfluxData, GitHub, GitHub, Pandas, Pandas, Pandas)

# Project Title: ai-ml-ds-MLTPatterns007
# File Name: advanced_multimodal_temporal_anomaly_pattern_mining_with_pandas.py

import pandas as pd
import dask.dataframe as dd
import numpy as np
import networkx as nx
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import DBSCAN
from pyod.models.iforest import IForest
from tsfresh import extract_features
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, TFAutoModel

def load_tabular(path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    return pd.read_csv(path, parse_dates=['timestamp'])

def load_logs(path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv(path, names=['timestamp','level','msg'])
    df['timestamp']=pd.to_datetime(df['timestamp'])
    return df

def embed_logs(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('distilbert-base-uncased')
    mdl=TFAutoModel.from_pretrained('distilbert-base-uncased')
    embs=[mdl(tok(m,return_tensors='tf',truncation=True,padding=True))[0][:,0,:].numpy().flatten() for m in df['msg']]
    return pd.DataFrame(embs,index=df.index)

def build_graph(df_rel: pd.DataFrame) -> nx.Graph:
    G=nx.from_pandas_edgelist(df_rel,'src','dst',create_using=nx.DiGraph())
    return G

def fuse_modalities(tab: pd.DataFrame, logs: pd.DataFrame, rel: pd.DataFrame):
    tab=tab.set_index('timestamp')
    logs=logs.set_index('timestamp')
    emb=embed_logs(logs)
    df=pd.concat([tab,emb],axis=1).ffill()
    G=build_graph(rel)
    deg=pd.Series(dict(G.degree()),name='degree')
    df['degree']=df.index.map(lambda t: deg.get(int(tab.loc[t,'entity']),0))
    return df.reset_index()

def extract_tsfeatures(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    fr, y = extract_features(df, column_id='entity', column_sort='timestamp', n_jobs=0)
    return fr

def detect_anomalies(df: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
    iso=IForest(contamination=0.02)
    iso.fit(df.values)
    return iso.labels_

def cluster_patterns(df: pd.DataFrame) -> np.ndarray:
    return DBSCAN(eps=0.5,min_samples=5).fit_predict(df.values)

if __name__=='__main__':
    tab: pd.DataFrame = load_tabular('sensor.csv')
    logs: pd.DataFrame = load_logs('app.log')
    rel: pd.DataFrame = pd.read_csv('relations.csv')
    df: pd.DataFrame = fuse_modalities(tab, logs, rel)
    feats: pd.DataFrame = extract_tsfeatures(df[['entity','value']])
    anomal: np.ndarray = detect_anomalies(feats)
    clusters: np.ndarray = cluster_patterns(feats)
    result: pd.DataFrame = pd.concat([feats,
                                      pd.Series(anomal,name='anomaly'),
                                      pd.Series(clusters,name='pattern')],
                                     axis=1)
    print(result.head())
